statement.name: Choice of a total planar tiling
statement.definition: Given a set S of Wang prototiles admitting a total planar tiling, return a total S-tiling Z^2 -> S.
statement.facts: Theorem 5.3.3: CT is strongly Weihrauch equivalent to closed choice on Baire space C_{N^N} (cnn).

statement.name: Choice of a weak planar tiling
statement.definition: Weak tiling principle (wild card tiles, infinite connected tiled region).
statement.facts: Theorem 5.4.3: C_{N^N} (cnn) is strongly Weihrauch equivalent to CWPT.

statement.name: Choice of infinite patch tiling
statement.definition: Weak tiling principle returning an infinite connected tiled region.
statement.facts: Theorem 5.4.7: C_{N^N} <=_W C_{2^omega} * CIPT (C_{2^omega} is closed choice on Cantor space, equivalent to WKL); Theorem 5.5.2 (cited in the proof): CIPT <=_sW C_{N^N}.

statement.name: Domino problem for Wang tiles
statement.definition: Given a set S of Wang prototiles (with wild card), return an S-tiling with an infinite connected patch.

statement.notation: CK(X) (compact choice), CI, CI-, BI, B
statement.name: Compact/interval choice and boundedness principles
statement.definition: Choice on compact sets of a computable metric space, on intervals of [0,1], and boundedness analogues.
statement.facts: Cited: Theorem 5.2.3 (CK(X) <=_W LLPO-hat, equivalence if 2^omega embeds computably), Theorem 5.2.8 (choice chains), Proposition 5.2.9 (B == C == LPO-hat, from Brattka-Gherardi).

statement.name: Carlson-Simpson Lemma
statement.definition: Unordered version: for every finite alphabet A and l-coloring of A^{<omega,n} there is an omega-variable word W such that {W[u] : u in A^{<omega,n}} is monochromatic.
statement.facts: ACA0 proves CSL_n for every standard n (Main Theorem 1.5); CSL_n implies ACA0 over RCA0 for n>=2; CSL_n <-> LCSL_n + RT^{n+1} (Lemma 8.5); forall n CSL_n equivalent to ACA0' (Theorem 7.7); CSL_0 follows from OVW0; CSL_1 admits preservation of 1 hyperimmunity (Theorem 8.1) and hence does not imply ACA0 (Main Theorem 1.6); CSL_1(1) does not admit preservation of 2 hyperimmunities (Lemma 8.2).

statement.name: Open Dual Ramsey theorem
statement.definition: Dual Ramsey theorem restricted to open colorings of (N)^n.
statement.facts: ACA0 proves ODRT_{n+2} for every n, reversal for n>=4 (Main Theorem 1.5); ODRT3 does not imply ACA0 (Main Theorem 1.6); CSL_n(1) implies ODRT_{n+2} (Lemma 7.5); ODRT_{n+1} implies RT^n (Miller-Solomon [37]); forall n ODRT_n equivalent to ACA0' (Theorem 7.7).

statement.name: Combinatorial Dual Ramsey theorem
statement.definition: Combinatorial core of ODRT_n, equal to CSL_{n-1}(0).
statement.facts: CSL_n(1) implies CDRT_{n+2} over RCA0 (Lemma 7.5); equivalent to ODRT_n over RCA0 (Dzhafarov-Flood-Solomon-Westrick [16]).
